## Design Checklist

- [ ] Uses design tokens (no hardcoded colors) and Tailwind classes mapped to tokens
- [ ] Uses canonical UI components (Button, Card, Alert, Skeleton, EmptyState) instead of ad‑hoc markup
- [ ] Loading uses Skeleton; empty uses EmptyState; error uses Alert
- [ ] Focus states are visible; keyboard navigation supported
- [ ] Responsive layout verified (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA
- [ ] Strings ready for i18n (no concatenated or hard-coded currency formats, use formatter utils)
